Pe  Through: Ms. Urvashi Bhatia, Adv.
 versus  STATE (NCT OF DELHI) .....

Re  Through: Ms. Richa Dhawan, APP for t  SI Narender Kumar, PS Ranho  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.02.2023 1.
Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
1. By this application, the petitioners seek condonation of 5 days' delay in filing the petition.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay is condoned.
3. Application stands disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed praying therein for setting aside order dated 10th November, 2022 passed by the Ld. ASJ in proceedings arising out of FIR No.102/2020 assailing framing of charges against the petitioners under sections 498A/304B/34 IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the complaint was lodged by the father of the deceased and a perusal of the FIR would reveal that there is a casual reference made to the petitioners, who are sister and brother-in-law of the husband of the deceased, regarding possible dowry demand.
However, these allegations have no specific particulars and are casual in nature.
It is further contended that petitioner no.2 was in fact responsible for match-making in the said marriage, since the deceased was sister of a friend of petitioner no.2.

Further, the petitioners were residing elsewhere and were never part of matrimonial home of the deceased and her husband,
since their home was around 7 km away from their home.

Despite these facts and circumstances,
charges against the petitioners have been framed, which are assailed herein.
3. Issue notice.
Ld. APP accepts notice.
Status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
